name: Signed Box Distance Function
definition: Operators: |·| is absolute value, k·k is length of vector, max/min are maximum/minimum operators. max(di, 0) applies the maximum operator to each component of vector di with 0.
summary: The Signed Box Distance Function computes the exact Euclidean distance to an axis-aligned box, distinguishing itself by handling faces, edges, and corners without underestimating the distance.
